C19 and C06 share the generic report-acknowledgment form but lack C09's distinctive institutional and substantive overlap.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Thank you for the report of the activities of the National Security Resources Board under your Chairmanship.","parent_excerpt":"I want to thank the National Security Resources Board and the interested Government agencies for the work they have done in answer to my request for advice","explanation":"Both open by thanking the same Board, through the same chairman, for report-based advisory work."},{"child_excerpt":"I have relied greatly on the advice of the Resources Board in formulating national policy","parent_excerpt":"This evaluation by the Board ... represents an important step in marking out the future role of the Federal Government in this important field.","explanation":"Both appraise the Board's report as materially useful for formulating future federal policy."},{"child_excerpt":"It is appropriate, therefore, to have a report at this time, summarizing to the extent possible, some of the major activities of the Board","parent_excerpt":"For this reason I believe that the recent report of the Board should be made public at this time so that it may receive full consideration","explanation":"Both explain why a Board report should be preserved or made available at that particular transitional moment."},{"child_excerpt":"constructive steps which our Government is taking to strengthen its security","parent_excerpt":"adopt constructive programs for the expansion of our economy while strengthening our security","explanation":"The letters share the coupled language of constructive governmental action and strengthening national security."}]}
